blind_rule: Written while the semantic index of the corpus was still being built and before any DEV measurement of Phase 4.10 part 2 existed. Every needle was admitted by COUNTING the chunks of the bounded corpus regulatory-core-v1 that match it - no retrieval was run on these questions, no query was embedded, no document title was looked at. Topics and needles are disjoint from probes-v1 and from BLIND TEST-2. The corpus is essentially English: counting showed that topical Turkish needles match one library header chunk per document rather than source text, so only three strict Turkish probes were admitted. A final run on this set is valid only with a configuration, a measurement method and acceptance criteria committed and pushed beforehand; after one run the set is a USED HOLDOUT.
